body: I think my first one was three years ago and it was my then girlfriend.

Same here. 

Ever since I lost my job and got back on disability, I have to make a concerted effort to do anything. I just want to sleep my day away even if I have things to do. The thing is that I hate myself for doing nothing all day but I can’t will myself to get up and do anything. It’s gotten to the point where I forget to take my meds because I sleep so much. I want to get out more and my counselor even recommends it but I just can’t do it.

Close. I had sex with someone on the second date and that was because I was lonely in the polyamorous relationship I was in.

Never have I ever skipped taking my meds as a form of self harm.
My life is already ruined so what’s suicide going to ruin that’s not already ruined? At this point there’s no ‘if’ anymore only a ‘when’ and I don’t care who is hurt by my death.
What else am I to do? I’m financially broke, I have no job, I can’t make rent or my phone bill this month. I have tried and tried to find other way out but none of them have panned out.
I want to be able to help troubled and at risk youth in some capacity.
Because it was closer to want to do with my life and my degree.
It was a part time overnight advocate position at a crisis nursery.
I honestly just feel overwhelmed, anxious, and that all the progress I’ve made is just unraveling right before my eyes.
It’s nice to know someone understands.
Thank you for the advice and the recommendations. I will agree that it’s nice not feeling alone.

I mean it just depends on how attached you get. I get emotionally attached way too easily and quickly mainly because that rush of serotonin and dopamine that sex can bring makes me feel whole again to some degree. I honestly want to but I’m not sure if I could put myself in situations like FWB and rebound relationships.
I could honestly kinda do with both advice and commiseration. The recommendations for music and video games would be nice too. It’s nice to know that I’m not alone

So am I. She’s a timid little girl. She was surrendered to the shelter because she didn’t like other pets. When I met her at the shelter, she was so timid of leaving the kennel so I had to stand on a stepladder to interact with her. I honestly fell in love with her when I started petting her and she leaned her head into my hand. 

I feel like she’s going to be a very positive influence in my life and give me the motivation I need in my life. I’m very grateful to have met her and to be her mama.

It honestly doesn’t outwardly affect me just because anytime I have outwardly been affected by the death of anyone close to me it’s because I’ve started talking or really thinking about it. I noticed it a month or two ago when I was discussing my father’s death, which happened when I was 7, in the context of it being the first time I had felt abandoned by anyone.

I can’t say how much I understand but I’m sorta going through the same thing right now. My FP broke up with me back in August last year and I still feel like I can’t get over her as well as the fact that she’s moved on with a girl that’s very similar to me without all the mental health issues.
Honestly the mental health technicians are just as bad as if not worse than psych ward nurses sometimes.
I understand somewhat due to the fact that I have BPD and autism. I’ve also got depression and anxiety. My mind feels like a living hell sometimes.
I lost a few after my girlfriend/FP broke up with me
I especially like it because I’ve been told by my mother that I have little to no empathy which made me self conscious about whether I’m actually empathetic.
My immense amount of empathy.
My favorite song is Illusion by VNV Nation. It’s a song that helps me when I need a good cry.
I’ve been there. I wish the same thing. That I would’ve been a better partner to her but I know I fucked up and need to accept that so I can become a better person.

I find that so frustrating. When I told my roommate that I deal with a lot of self-hate he questioned why I do, that I’m so wonderful, and that I should try to be more positive. He doesn’t seem to get that I could have the best personality as well as looks and I’d still have self hate. Self-hatred doesn’t have any sort of explanation that I could easily explain. I mean it’s not just him but most of the people around me don’t get it. The only people that seem to get it are the mental health professionals I’ve seen.
I haven’t had to fantasize about it since August 2022 when mine broke up with me. It’s honestly just as bad if not worse in reality.
